```{=html}
</style>


<script>

/* =========================================================
   BINOMIAL DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {

  const nInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-n");

  const pInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-p");

  const xInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-x");

  const lowerInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-lower");

  const upperInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-upper");

  const pDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-p-value");

  const xDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-x-value");

  const lowerDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-lower-value");

  const upperDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-upper-value");

  const title =
    document.getElementById("binomial-plot-title");

  const result =
    document.getElementById("binomial-result");

  const xContainer =
    document.getElementById("binomial-x-container");

  const betweenContainer =
    document.getElementById("binomial-between-container");

  const canvas =
    document.getElementById("binomial-chart");

  const ctx =
    canvas.getContext("2d");


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     BINOMIAL PMF
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function logGamma(z) {

    const coefficients = [
      676.5203681218851,
      -1259.1392167224028,
      771.32342877765313,
      -176.61502916214059,
      12.507343278686905,
      -0.13857109526572012,
      9.9843695780195716e-6,
      1.5056327351493116e-7
    ];

    if (z < 0.5) {
      return Math.log(Math.PI)
        - Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * z))
        - logGamma(1 - z);
    }

    z -= 1;

    let x = 0.99999999999980993;

    for (let i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
      x += coefficients[i] / (z + i + 1);
    }

    const t = z + coefficients.length - 0.5;

    return (
      0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) +
      (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) -
      t +
      Math.log(x)
    );
  }


  function binomialPMF(k, n, p) {

    if (k < 0 || k > n) {
      return 0;
    }

    if (p === 0) {
      return k === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }

    if (p === 1) {
      return k === n ? 1 : 0;
    }

    const logProbability =
      logGamma(n + 1) -
      logGamma(k + 1) -
      logGamma(n - k + 1) +
      k * Math.log(p) +
      (n - k) * Math.log(1 - p);

    return Math.exp(logProbability);
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CUMULATIVE PROBABILITY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function cumulativeProbability(k, n, p) {

    if (k < 0) return 0;

    if (k >= n) return 1;

    let total = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
      total += binomialPMF(i, n, p);
    }

    return total;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CURRENT TEST TYPE
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function getTestType() {

    const selected =
      document.querySelector(
        'input[name="binomial-prob-type"]:checked'
      );

    return selected
      ? selected.value
      : "less";
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     UPDATE SLIDER RANGES
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateRanges() {

    let n =
      parseInt(nInput.value, 10);

    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1) {
      n = 1;
      nInput.value = 1;
    }

    xInput.max = n;
    lowerInput.max = n;
    upperInput.max = n;

    if (parseInt(xInput.value,10) > n) {
      xInput.value = n;
    }

    if (parseInt(lowerInput.value,10) > n) {
      lowerInput.value = n;
    }

    if (parseInt(upperInput.value,10) > n) {
      upperInput.value = n;
    }

    if (
      parseInt(upperInput.value,10) <
      parseInt(lowerInput.value,10)
    ) {
      upperInput.value =
        lowerInput.value;
    }

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     UPDATE DISPLAY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateDisplay() {

    updateRanges();

    const n =
      parseInt(nInput.value,10);

    const p =
      parseFloat(pInput.value);

    const x =
      parseInt(xInput.value,10);

    const lower =
      parseInt(lowerInput.value,10);

    const upper =
      parseInt(upperInput.value,10);

    pDisplay.textContent =
      p.toFixed(2);

    xDisplay.textContent =
      x;

    lowerDisplay.textContent =
      lower;

    upperDisplay.textContent =
      upper;

    title.textContent =
      `Bin(n = ${n}, p = ${p.toFixed(2)})`;

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CALCULATE RESULT
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function calculateProbability() {

    const n =
      parseInt(nInput.value,10);

    const p =
      parseFloat(pInput.value);

    const x =
      parseInt(xInput.value,10);

    let lower =
      parseInt(lowerInput.value,10);

    let upper =
      parseInt(upperInput.value,10);

    const type =
      getTestType();


    if (upper < lower) {

      upper = lower;

      upperInput.value =
        upper;

      upperDisplay.textContent =
        upper;

    }


    let probability;


    if (type === "less") {

      probability =
        cumulativeProbability(
          x,
          n,
          p
        );

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${x}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;

    }


    else if (type === "greater") {

      if (x === 0) {

        probability = 1;

      } else {

        probability =
          1 -
          cumulativeProbability(
            x - 1,
            n,
            p
          );

      }

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${x}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;

    }


    else {

      if (lower === upper) {

        probability =
          binomialPMF(
            lower,
            n,
            p
          );

      } else {

        const upperProbability =
          cumulativeProbability(
            upper,
            n,
            p
          );

        const lowerProbability =
          lower === 0
            ? 0
            : cumulativeProbability(
                lower - 1,
                n,
                p
              );

        probability =
          upperProbability -
          lowerProbability;

      }

      result.textContent =
        `P(${lower} ≤ X ≤ ${upper}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;

    }


    return {
      type,
      x,
      lower,
      upper,
      probability
    };

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     DRAW CHART
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function drawChart() {

    const n =
      parseInt(nInput.value,10);

    const p =
      parseFloat(pInput.value);

    const res =
      calculateProbability();


    const rect =
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    const dpr =
      window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

    canvas.width =
      rect.width * dpr;

    canvas.height =
      rect.height * dpr;

    ctx.setTransform(
      dpr,
      0,
      0,
      dpr,
      0,
      0
    );


    const width =
      rect.width;

    const height =
      rect.height;


    ctx.clearRect(
      0,
      0,
      width,
      height
    );


    const padding = {
      left: 55,
      right: 20,
      top: 25,
      bottom: 50
    };


    const chartWidth =
      width -
      padding.left -
      padding.right;

    const chartHeight =
      height -
      padding.top -
      padding.bottom;


    const probabilities = [];

    for(let k=0;k<=n;k++) {

      probabilities.push(
        binomialPMF(k,n,p)
      );

    }


    const maxProbability =
      Math.max(...probabilities);


    function xScale(k) {

      if(n === 0) {
        return padding.left;
      }

      return padding.left +
        (k / n) *
        chartWidth;

    }


    function yScale(value) {

      return padding.top +
        chartHeight -
        (value / maxProbability) *
        chartHeight *
        0.9;

    }


    /* GRID */

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "#e5e5e5";

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    for(let i=0;i<=4;i++) {

      const y =
        padding.top +
        chartHeight -
        (i/4) *
        chartHeight;

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.moveTo(
        padding.left,
        y
      );

      ctx.lineTo(
        width - padding.right,
        y
      );

      ctx.stroke();

    }


    /* AXIS */

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "#777";

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(
      padding.left,
      padding.top + chartHeight
    );

    ctx.lineTo(
      width - padding.right,
      padding.top + chartHeight
    );

    ctx.stroke();


    /* BARS */

    const barWidth =
      Math.max(
        2,
        Math.min(
          40,
          chartWidth / (n + 1) * 0.72
        )
      );


    for(let k=0;k<=n;k++) {

      const probability =
        probabilities[k];

      const barHeight =
        (probability / maxProbability) *
        chartHeight *
        0.9;

      const x =
        xScale(k) -
        barWidth / 2;

      const y =
        padding.top +
        chartHeight -
        barHeight;


      let highlighted = false;


      if(res.type === "less") {

        highlighted =
          k <= res.x;

      }

      else if(res.type === "greater") {

        highlighted =
          k >= res.x;

      }

      else if(res.type === "between") {

        highlighted =
          k >= res.lower &&
          k <= res.upper;

      }


      ctx.fillStyle =
        highlighted
          ? "#3F6BB6"
          : "#d3d3d3";


      ctx.fillRect(
        x,
        y,
        barWidth,
        barHeight
      );


      ctx.strokeStyle =
        "#777";

      ctx.strokeRect(
        x,
        y,
        barWidth,
        barHeight
      );

    }


    /* X AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.fillStyle =
      "#333";

    ctx.font =
      "12px Arial";

    ctx.textAlign =
      "center";

    for(let k=0;k<=n;k++) {

      const x =
        xScale(k);

      ctx.fillText(
        k,
        x,
        padding.top +
        chartHeight +
        20
      );

    }


    /* X LABEL */

    ctx.font =
      "13px Arial";

    ctx.fillText(
      "number of successes (X)",
      padding.left +
      chartWidth/2,
      height - 8
    );


    /* Y LABEL */

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(
      15,
      padding.top +
      chartHeight/2
    );

    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);

    ctx.textAlign =
      "center";

    ctx.fillText(
      "probability mass function",
      0,
      0
    );

    ctx.restore();

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     VISIBILITY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateVisibility() {

    const type =
      getTestType();

    if(
      type === "less" ||
      type === "greater"
    ) {

      xContainer.hidden = false;

      betweenContainer.hidden = true;

    } else {

      xContainer.hidden = true;

      betweenContainer.hidden = false;

    }

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     MASTER UPDATE
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function update() {

    updateVisibility();

    updateDisplay();

    drawChart();

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     EVENT LISTENERS
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  nInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );

  pInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );

  xInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );

  lowerInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    function() {

      if(
        parseInt(upperInput.value,10) <
        parseInt(lowerInput.value,10)
      ) {

        upperInput.value =
          lowerInput.value;

      }

      update();

    }
  );

  upperInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );


  document
    .querySelectorAll(
      'input[name="binomial-prob-type"]'
    )
    .forEach(
      radio =>
        radio.addEventListener(
          "change",
          update
        )
    );


  window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    drawChart
  );


  /* INITIALISE */

  update();

})();

</script>

```

![An example of the binomial distribution with $n = 20$ and $p = 0.4$.](./FiguresPNG/f-binomialdist.png){width="80%"}

:::



**Where to use:** The binomial distribution is used when there are a fixed number of trials ($n$) and only two possible outcomes for each trial, representing $n$ many Bernoulli trials. Here, the random variable $X$ represents the number of successes.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Binomial}(n,p)$ or $X \sim B(n,p)$.

**Parameters:** Two numbers $n,p$ where: - $n$ is an integer representing the number of trials, - $p$ is a real number representing the probability of success of a trial (where $0 \le p \le 1$).

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:--------|:----------------------------|:-------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = np$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = np(1-p)$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{n!}{(n-x)!x!}p^xq^{(n-x)}$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=I_{q}(n-\lfloor x \rfloor,1+\lfloor x \rfloor)$ | $I_x(a,b)$ regularized incomplete beta function, $\lfloor x \rfloor$ the floor function |

**Example:** You flip a coin $10$ times, and the probability of getting ‘heads’ is $0.5$. Taking ‘heads’ as a success, this can be expressed as $X \sim B(10, 0.5)$, meaning $10$ trials are conducted, where the probability of success in each trial is $0.5$.
